I can see why that’s frustrating.

With the tools I have here, I’m only able to look up reservations by confirmation code, not by guest name or restaurant, so I can’t directly search for “Kevin O’Brien” at that restaurant in this system.

Do you see any other confirmation codes in your messages from that restaurant?</action>
